fields.design:
## Constraints

- A reset link is valid once, for 30 minutes.
- Nothing tells whether an email has an account.

## Design

A signed, single-use token in the link; the new password is checked against the breached-password list.
fields.goal:
Customers reset a forgotten password themselves, by email, without calling support.

Success: support's password tickets drop by half within a month of the release.
fields.title: Self-service password reset
fields.verification:
- The backend's tests cover expiry and reuse.
- The acceptance protocol has a case for each step.

fields.context: Longer links are easier on customers; shorter ones leak less.
fields.decision: A reset token expires 30 minutes after it is sent, and on first use.

fields.why: What the bank's and the mail provider's own resets do; support saw no complaints there.

fields.context: Reset requests send email, which costs money and can be abused.
fields.decision: At most five reset requests an hour for one email, and fifty for one address.
